# Public API surface

Every published entry point of every publishable package, in one file, so the
whole surface can be read in a single pass — which is what a coding agent
needs and what the per-entry-point reports under `packages/*/etc/` are the
wrong shape for. Those reports are still the artifact a REVIEWER reads: a
signature change lands in the one that owns it, and `pnpm check:api-report`
gates both.

Sections are the reports verbatim, so anything true of them is true here —
these are the rolled-up public `.d.ts` of each entry point, not prose, and a
symbol exported from two subpaths appears under both.

type ToolConditionOperator = "eq" | "neq" | "gt" | "gte" | "lt" | "lte";

// @public @sealed
type ToolContext = {
    env: Readonly<Partial<Record<string, string>>>;
    slots: SlotStore;
    generate: GenerateFn;
    delegate: DelegateFn;
    messages: readonly Message[];
    sessionId: string;
    send: ClientEventSender;
    speech: SessionSpeech;
    signal: AbortSignal;
    deadlineAt: number;
    workflows: WorkflowClient;
    random: RandomSource;
    turn: number;
    now(): number;
};

// @public @input
type ToolDef<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema | undefined, R = unknown> = {
    description: string;
    inputSchema?: P | undefined;
    execute(args: InferSchemaOutput<P>, ctx: ToolContext): R;
    onError?: ToolErrorHandler;
    messages?: ToolMessagesInput;
    ui?: ToolUi;
};

// @public @input
type ToolDelayedMessage = {
    content: string;
    when?: ToolMessageCondition[] | undefined;
    afterMs: number;
};

// @public
type ToolErrorHandler = (err: unknown, ctx: ToolContext) => ToolFailure | string;

// @public
type ToolFailure = {
    error: string;
};

// @public
type ToolInputSchema = StandardSchemaV1<unknown, Record<string, unknown>>;

// @public
type ToolMap = Readonly<Record<string, ToolDef>>;

// @public @input
type ToolMessageCondition = {
    arg: string;
    op?: ToolConditionOperator | undefined;
    value: string | number | boolean | null;
};

// @public @input
type ToolMessagesInput = {
    start?: boolean | string | readonly (string | ToolStartMessage)[];
    delayed?: readonly ToolDelayedMessage[];
    complete?: string | readonly (string | ToolCompletionMessage)[];
    failed?: string | readonly (string | ToolCompletionMessage)[];
};

// @public @input
type ToolStartMessage = {
    content: string;
    when?: ToolMessageCondition[] | undefined;
    blocking?: boolean | undefined;
};

// @public @input
type ToolUi = {
    icon?: string | undefined;
    label?: string | undefined;
};

// @public
type TurnDetectionMode = "auto" | "manual" | (string & {});

// @public @input
interface TurnTakingTuning {
    detection?: TurnDetectionMode;
    maxSilenceMs?: number;
    minSilenceMs?: number;
    preemptiveGeneration?: boolean;
    startSpeakingFloorMs?: number;
    userTurnLimit?: UserTurnLimit;
}

// @public @sealed
interface TypedDelegateResult<T> extends DelegateResult {
    object: T;
}

// @public @input
interface TypedSpeakerDef<T, N extends string = string> extends SpeakerDef<N> {
    // (undocumented)
    schema: StandardSchemaV1<unknown, T>;
}

// @public @input
interface UserTurnLimit {
    maxDurationMs?: number | undefined;
    maxWords?: number | undefined;
}

// @public @input
type WaitForOptions<S extends StandardSchemaV1 = StandardSchemaV1> = {
    timeoutMs: number;
    schema?: S | undefined;
};

// @public @input
type WaitForSchemaOptions<S extends StandardSchemaV1 = StandardSchemaV1> = {
    schema: S;
};

// @public @input
type WakeUpOptions = {
    correlationIds?: string[];
};

// @public
type WorkflowBody<I = unknown, R = unknown> = (input: I, ctx: WorkflowContext) => Promise<R> | R;

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowClient = {
    start<P extends ToolInputSchema, R>(workflow: WorkflowDef<P, R>,
    input: InferSchemaOutput<P>, options?: StartOptions): Promise<string>;
    start(workflow: string, input?: unknown, options?: StartOptions): Promise<string>;
    get<R>(runId: string, workflow: AnyWorkflowDef<R>): Promise<WorkflowRunSnapshot<R> | undefined>;
    get(runId: string): Promise<WorkflowRunSnapshot | undefined>;
    find<P extends ToolInputSchema, R>(workflow: WorkflowDef<P, R>, key: string, options?: FindOptions): Promise<WorkflowRunSnapshot<R>[]>;
    find(workflow: string, key: string, options?: FindOptions): Promise<WorkflowRunSnapshot[]>;
    latest<P extends ToolInputSchema, R>(workflow: WorkflowDef<P, R>, key?: string): Promise<WorkflowRunSnapshot<R> | undefined>;
    latest(workflow: string, key?: string): Promise<WorkflowRunSnapshot | undefined>;
    live<P extends ToolInputSchema, R>(workflow: WorkflowDef<P, R>, key?: string): Promise<WorkflowRunSnapshot<R> | undefined>;
    live(workflow: string, key?: string): Promise<WorkflowRunSnapshot | undefined>;
    findByKey(key: string, options?: FindByKeyOptions): Promise<WorkflowRunSnapshot[]>;
    cancelAll<P extends ToolInputSchema, R>(workflow: WorkflowDef<P, R>, key: string): Promise<number>;
    cancelAll(workflow: string, key: string): Promise<number>;
    recent<P extends ToolInputSchema, R>(workflow: WorkflowDef<P, R>, options?: FindOptions): Promise<WorkflowRunSnapshot<R>[]>;
    recent(workflow: string, options?: FindOptions): Promise<WorkflowRunSnapshot[]>;
    cancel(runId: string): Promise<boolean>;
    wakeUp(runId: string, options?: WakeUpOptions): Promise<number>;
    signal(token: string, payload?: unknown, options?: SignalOptions): Promise<boolean>;
    signalRun<P extends ToolInputSchema, R>(workflow: WorkflowDef<P, R>, key: string, label: string, payload?: unknown, options?: SignalOptions): Promise<boolean>;
    signalRun(workflow: string, key: string, label: string, payload?: unknown, options?: SignalOptions): Promise<boolean>;
    stream(runId: string, options?: StreamOptions): Promise<ReadableStream<unknown>>;
    streamTail(runId: string, options?: StreamOptions): Promise<number>;
    lastLine(runId: string, options?: StreamOptions): Promise<unknown | undefined>;
    publicWebhookUrl(token: string): string;
    listing(): WorkflowSummary[];
};

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowContext = {
    readonly runId: string;
    readonly workflow: string;
    readonly key: string | undefined;
    step<S extends StandardSchemaV1, const Name extends string>(name: Name & Literal<Name>, fn: () => unknown, options: StepSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S>>;
    step<T, const Name extends string>(name: Name & Literal<Name>, fn: () => Promise<T> | T, options?: StepOptions): Promise<T>;
    now(): Promise<number>;
    random(): Promise<number>;
    uuid(): Promise<string>;
    sleep<const Label extends string>(label: Label & Literal<Label>, until: number | Date, options?: SleepOptions): Promise<void>;
    poll<T, const Name extends string>(name: Name & Literal<Name>, check: () => Promise<T> | T, options: PollOptions<T>): Promise<PollResult<T>>;
    sayOnClient<const Name extends string>(name: Name & Literal<Name>, clientId: string, notice: SayOnClientNotice): Promise<string>;
    waitFor<S extends StandardSchemaV1>(token: string, options: WaitForOptions<S> & WaitForSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S> | undefined>;
    waitFor<S extends StandardSchemaV1>(token: string, options: WaitForSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S>>;
    waitFor<T = unknown>(token: string): Promise<T>;
    waitFor<T = unknown>(token: string, options: WaitForOptions): Promise<T | undefined>;
    report<const Name extends string>(name: Name & Literal<Name>, line: string): Promise<void>;
    signalToken(label: string): string;
    waitForSignal<S extends StandardSchemaV1>(label: string, options: WaitForOptions<S> & WaitForSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S> | undefined>;
    waitForSignal<S extends StandardSchemaV1>(label: string, options: WaitForSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S>>;
    waitForSignal<T = unknown>(label: string): Promise<T>;
    waitForSignal<T = unknown>(label: string, options: WaitForOptions): Promise<T | undefined>;
};

// @public @input
type WorkflowDef<P extends ToolInputSchema = ToolInputSchema, R = unknown> = {
    description?: string;
    input?: P;
    uploads?: readonly string[];
    output?: StandardSchemaV1<unknown, R>;
    run: WorkflowBody<InferSchemaOutput<P>, R>;
    onFailure?: WorkflowFailureHandler<InferSchemaOutput<P>> | undefined;
    describeRun?(run: WorkflowRunSnapshot<R>): string;
    cancelNote?: string | undefined;
};

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowFailureContext<I = unknown> = {
    readonly runId: string;
    readonly workflow: string;
    readonly input: I;
};

// @public
type WorkflowFailureHandler<I = unknown> = WorkflowFailureHook<I> | {
    run: WorkflowFailureHook<I>;
    maxAttempts?: number | undefined;
};

// @public
type WorkflowFailureHook<I = unknown> = (error: Error, context: WorkflowFailureContext<I>) => Promise<void> | void;

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowRunBase = {
    runId: string;
    workflow: string;
    createdAt: number;
    key?: string;
    label?: string;
    startedAt?: number;
    settledAt?: number;
};

// @public
type WorkflowRunSnapshot<R = unknown> = (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "pending" | "running";
})
/** `output` is what the workflow function returned. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "completed";
    output: R;
})
/** `error` is the failure message. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "failed";
    error: string;
})
/** Cancelled by {@link WorkflowClient.cancel}; it produced no output. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "cancelled";
});

// @public
type WorkflowRunStatus = "pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed" | "cancelled";

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowSummary = {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    inputSchema?: unknown;
    outputSchema?: unknown;
    uploads?: readonly string[];
};

// @public
export function describeMedia(info: MediaInfo): string;

// @public
export function ffmpegBaseArgs(options?: {
    loglevel?: string;
}): string[];

// @public
export class FfmpegError extends Error {
    constructor(options: {
        kind: FfmpegFailureKind;
        message: string;
        binary: string;
        argv: readonly string[];
        exitCode?: number | null;
        signal?: NodeJS.Signals | null;
        stderr?: string;
        cause?: unknown;
    });
    // (undocumented)
    readonly argv: readonly string[];
    readonly binary: string;
    readonly exitCode: number | null;
    // (undocumented)
    readonly kind: FfmpegFailureKind;
    readonly signal: NodeJS.Signals | null;
    readonly stderr: string;
}

// @public
export type FfmpegFailureKind =
/** The binary ran and exited non-zero. Almost always the input, not the run. */
"exit"
/** Killed at `timeoutMs`. */
| "timeout"
/** Killed because the caller's `signal` aborted. */
| "aborted"
/** The binary is not installed, or `AAI_FFMPEG_PATH` points at nothing. */
| "missing-binary"
/** Piped output passed `maxOutputBytes`; the child was killed. */
| "output-too-large" | (string & {});

// @public @input (undocumented)
export type FfmpegRunOptions = {
    binary?: string;
    cwd?: string;
    stdin?: Uint8Array;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
    timeoutMs?: number;
    maxOutputBytes?: number;
};

// @public @sealed (undocumented)
export type FfmpegRunResult = {
    stdout: Uint8Array;
    stderr: string;
    durationMs: number;
};

// @public
export type FfmpegSource = string | Uint8Array;

// @public
export function isFfmpegError(value: unknown): value is FfmpegError;

// @public @sealed
export type MediaInfo = {
    durationSec?: number;
    format?: string;
    bitRate?: number;
    sizeBytes?: number;
    streams: MediaStreamInfo[];
    audio?: MediaStreamInfo;
    video?: MediaStreamInfo;
    raw: unknown;
};

// @public @sealed
export type MediaStreamInfo = {
    index: number;
    kind: string;
    codec?: string;
    sampleRate?: number;
    channels?: number;
    sampleFormat?: string;
    width?: number;
    height?: number;
    durationSec?: number;
};

// @public
export function probeMedia(source: FfmpegSource, options?: ProbeOptions): Promise<MediaInfo>;

// @public @input (undocumented)
export type ProbeOptions = Omit<FfmpegRunOptions, "stdin" | "binary"> & {
    binary?: string;
};

// @public
export function runFfmpeg(args: readonly string[], options?: FfmpegRunOptions): Promise<FfmpegRunResult>;

// @public
export function transcodeToWav(source: FfmpegSource, options?: TranscodeToWavOptions): Promise<Uint8Array>;

// @public (undocumented)
export type TranscodeToWavOptions = WavEncodeOptions & Omit<FfmpegRunOptions, "stdin">;

// @public
export function wavEncodeArgs(options?: WavEncodeOptions): string[];

// @public @input (undocumented)
export type WavEncodeOptions = {
    sampleRate?: number;
    channels?: number;
    bitsPerSample?: 16 | 24 | 32;
};

};

// @public
type WorkflowRunSnapshot<R = unknown> = (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "pending" | "running";
})
/** `output` is what the workflow function returned. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "completed";
    output: R;
})
/** `error` is the failure message. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "failed";
    error: string;
})
/** Cancelled by {@link WorkflowClient.cancel}; it produced no output. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "cancelled";
});

// @public
type WorkflowRunStatus = "pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed" | "cancelled";

export function workflowSignalToken(workflow: string, key: string, label: string): string;

type WorkflowSummary = {
    name: string;
    description?: string;

    outputSchema?: unknown;
    uploads?: readonly string[];
};

// @internal
export function writeSessionEntry<K, V>(map: Map<K, V>, key: K, entry: V, max: number): void;

        type: "metrics.collected";

        } | undefined;
    };
    "provider.failedOver": {
        type: "provider.failedOver";

        from: string;
        to: string;
        reason: string;
    };
    "reply.cancelled": {
        type: "reply.cancelled";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "reply.completed": {
        type: "reply.completed";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "session.configured": {
        type: "session.configured";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        audioFormat: string;

        ttsSampleRate: number;
        sessionId: string;
    };
    "session.reset": {
        type: "session.reset";

    };
    "session.timedOut": {
        type: "session.timedOut";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "speech.started": {
        type: "speech.started";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    // (undocumented)
    "speech.stopped": {
        type: "speech.stopped";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "state.updated": {
        type: "state.updated";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        state: Record<string, unknown>;
    };
    // (undocumented)

        type: "tool.called";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;

        type: "tool.completed";

    "userTranscript.committed": {

// @public @sealed
export interface SessionSlot<K extends string, T, V = DeepReadonly<T>> {

    snapshot(ctx: SlotHolder): T;
    tool<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema, R = unknown, E extends {
        type: string;
    } = {
        type: string;
    }, K extends string = string>(def: SlotToolDef<P, DeepReadonly<T>, R> & SlotDialogGate<R, E, K> & NoInfer<DialogSendFromGuard<K, Awaited<R>, E>>, options?: DialogSendOptions<Awaited<R>, E, K>): DialogSendFromChecked<K, Awaited<R>, E, ToolDef<P, GatedOutput<R>>>;
    // (undocumented)
    tool<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema, R = unknown>(def: SlotToolDef<P, DeepReadonly<T>, R> & UngatedDef): ToolDef<P, R>;
    transact<Prep, R>(ctx: SlotHolder, tx: SlotTransaction<T, Prep, R>): Promise<R | ToolFailure>;
    update<R>(ctx: SlotHolder, mutate: (draft: T) => R): RejectThenableResult<R>;
    updateTool<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema, Prep = unknown, R = unknown, R2 = R, E extends {
        type: string;
    } = {
        type: string;
    }, K extends string = string>(def: SlotPreparedToolDef<P, T, Prep, R, R2> & SlotDialogGate<R2, E, K> & RejectThenable<R> & NoInfer<DialogSendFromGuard<K, Awaited<R2>, E>>, options?: DialogSendOptions<R2, E, K>): DialogSendFromChecked<K, Awaited<R2>, E, ToolDef<P, GatedOutput<R2>>>;
    // (undocumented)
    updateTool<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema, Prep = unknown, R = unknown, R2 = R>(def: SlotPreparedToolDef<P, T, Prep, R, R2> & RejectThenable<R> & UngatedDef): ToolDef<P, Promise<R2 | ToolFailure>>;
    // (undocumented)
    updateTool<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema, R = unknown, R2 = R, E extends {
        type: string;
    } = {
        type: string;
    }, K extends string = string>(def: SlotUpdateToolDef<P, T, R, R2> & SlotDialogGate<R2, E, K> & RejectThenable<R> & NoInfer<DialogSendFromGuard<K, Awaited<R2>, E>>, options?: DialogSendOptions<R2, E, K>): DialogSendFromChecked<K, Awaited<R2>, E, ToolDef<P, GatedOutput<R2>>>;
    // (undocumented)
    updateTool<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema, R = unknown, R2 = R>(def: SlotUpdateToolDef<P, T, R, R2> & RejectThenable<R> & UngatedDef): ToolDef<P, R2 | Extract<R, ToolFailure>>;
}

    describeRun?(run: WorkflowRunSnapshot<R>): string;
    cancelNote?: string | undefined;
};

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowFailureContext<I = unknown> = {
    readonly runId: string;
    readonly workflow: string;
    readonly input: I;
};

// @public
type WorkflowFailureHandler<I = unknown> = WorkflowFailureHook<I> | {
    run: WorkflowFailureHook<I>;
    maxAttempts?: number | undefined;
};

// @public
type WorkflowFailureHook<I = unknown> = (error: Error, context: WorkflowFailureContext<I>) => Promise<void> | void;

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowRunBase = {
    runId: string;
    workflow: string;
    createdAt: number;
    key?: string;
    label?: string;
    startedAt?: number;
    settledAt?: number;
};

// @public
type WorkflowRunSnapshot<R = unknown> = (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "pending" | "running";
})
/** `output` is what the workflow function returned. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "completed";
    output: R;
})
/** `error` is the failure message. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "failed";
    error: string;
})
/** Cancelled by {@link WorkflowClient.cancel}; it produced no output. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "cancelled";
});

// @public
type WorkflowRunStatus = "pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed" | "cancelled";

// @internal
export const WORKFLOWS_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE: string;

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowSummary = {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    inputSchema?: unknown;
    outputSchema?: unknown;
    uploads?: readonly string[];
};

// @internal (undocumented)
export const WS_OPEN = 1;

// @public @sealed
interface SessionEventMap {
    "agentTranscript.committed": {
        type: "agentTranscript.committed";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        text: string;
        recovery?: AgentTranscriptRecovery | undefined;
        recorded?: false | undefined;
    };
    "agentTranscript.updated": {
        type: "agentTranscript.updated";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        text: string;
    };
    "audio.completed": {
        type: "audio.completed";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "custom.emitted": {
        type: "custom.emitted";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        event: string;
        data: unknown;
    };
    // (undocumented)
    "error.reported": {
        type: "error.reported";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        code: SessionErrorCode;
        message: string;
        fatal: boolean;
    };
    "guardrail.blocked": {
        type: "guardrail.blocked";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        direction: "input" | "output" | (string & {});
        replacement: string;
    };
    "history.restored": {
        type: "history.restored";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        messages: {
            role: "user" | "assistant";
            content: string;
        }[];
        toolCalls: RestoredToolCall[];
    };
    "metrics.collected": {
        type: "metrics.collected";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        interrupted: boolean;
        latencyMs?: number | undefined;
        stt?: {
            endpointingMs?: number | undefined;
        } | undefined;
        llm?: {
            ttftMs?: number | undefined;
            durationMs: number;
            steps: number;
            inputTokens?: number | undefined;
            outputTokens?: number | undefined;
        } | undefined;
        tts?: {
            ttfbMs?: number | undefined;
            characters: number;
        } | undefined;
    };
    "provider.failedOver": {
        type: "provider.failedOver";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        stage: "stt" | "llm" | "tts" | (string & {});
        from: string;
        to: string;
        reason: string;
    };
    "reply.cancelled": {
        type: "reply.cancelled";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "reply.completed": {
        type: "reply.completed";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "session.configured": {
        type: "session.configured";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        audioFormat: string;
        sampleRate: number;
        ttsSampleRate: number;
        sessionId: string;
    };
    "session.reset": {
        type: "session.reset";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "session.timedOut": {
        type: "session.timedOut";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "speech.started": {
        type: "speech.started";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    // (undocumented)
    "speech.stopped": {
        type: "speech.stopped";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "state.updated": {
        type: "state.updated";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        state: Record<string, unknown>;
    };
    // (undocumented)
    "tool.called": {
        type: "tool.called";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        toolCallId: string;
        toolName: string;
        args: Record<string, unknown>;
    };
    // (undocumented)
    "tool.completed": {
        type: "tool.completed";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        toolCallId: string;
        result: string;
    };
    "usage.updated": {
        type: "usage.updated";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        inputTokens: number;
        outputTokens: number;
        totalTokens: number;
        steps: number;
    };
    "userTranscript.committed": {
        type: "userTranscript.committed";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        text: string;
    };
    "userTranscript.updated": {
        type: "userTranscript.updated";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        text: string;
        eotConfidence?: number | undefined;
    };
    "userTurn.exceeded": {
        type: "userTurn.exceeded";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        limit: "words" | "duration" | (string & {});
        words: number;
        durationMs: number;
    };
}

// @internal
export const ToolSchemaSchema: z.ZodObject<{
    type: z.ZodLiteral<"function">;
    name: z.ZodString;
    description: z.ZodString;
    parameters: z.ZodRecord<z.ZodString, z.ZodUnknown>;
    messages: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodObject<{
        start: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
            content: z.ZodString;
            when: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
                arg: z.ZodString;
                op: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodEnum<{
                    eq: "eq";
                    gt: "gt";
                    gte: "gte";
                    lt: "lt";
                    lte: "lte";
                    neq: "neq";
                }>>;
                value: z.ZodUnion<readonly [z.ZodString, z.ZodNumber, z.ZodBoolean, z.ZodNull]>;
            }, z.core.$strip>>>;
            blocking: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodBoolean>;
        }, z.core.$strip>>>;
        delayed: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
            content: z.ZodString;
            when: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
                arg: z.ZodString;
                op: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodEnum<{
                    eq: "eq";
                    gt: "gt";
                    gte: "gte";
                    lt: "lt";
                    lte: "lte";
                    neq: "neq";
                }>>;
                value: z.ZodUnion<readonly [z.ZodString, z.ZodNumber, z.ZodBoolean, z.ZodNull]>;
            }, z.core.$strip>>>;
            afterMs: z.ZodNumber;
        }, z.core.$strip>>>;
        complete: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
            content: z.ZodString;
            when: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
                arg: z.ZodString;
                op: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodEnum<{
                    eq: "eq";
                    gt: "gt";
                    gte: "gte";
                    lt: "lt";
                    lte: "lte";
                    neq: "neq";
                }>>;
                value: z.ZodUnion<readonly [z.ZodString, z.ZodNumber, z.ZodBoolean, z.ZodNull]>;
            }, z.core.$strip>>>;
            role: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodEnum<{
                assistant: "assistant";
                system: "system";
            }>>;
        }, z.core.$strip>>>;
        failed: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
            content: z.ZodString;
            when: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
                arg: z.ZodString;
                op: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodEnum<{
                    eq: "eq";
                    gt: "gt";
                    gte: "gte";
                    lt: "lt";
                    lte: "lte";
                    neq: "neq";
                }>>;
                value: z.ZodUnion<readonly [z.ZodString, z.ZodNumber, z.ZodBoolean, z.ZodNull]>;
            }, z.core.$strip>>>;
            role: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodEnum<{
                assistant: "assistant";
                system: "system";
            }>>;
        }, z.core.$strip>>>;
    }, z.core.$strip>>;
    ui: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodType<ToolUi>>;
}, z.core.$strip>;

    signalRun(workflow: string, key: string, label: string, payload?: unknown, options?: SignalOptions): Promise<boolean>;
    stream(runId: string, options?: StreamOptions): Promise<ReadableStream<unknown>>;
    streamTail(runId: string, options?: StreamOptions): Promise<number>;
    lastLine(runId: string, options?: StreamOptions): Promise<unknown | undefined>;
    publicWebhookUrl(token: string): string;
    listing(): WorkflowSummary[];
};

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowContext = {
    readonly runId: string;
    readonly workflow: string;
    readonly key: string | undefined;
    step<S extends StandardSchemaV1, const Name extends string>(name: Name & Literal<Name>, fn: () => unknown, options: StepSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S>>;
    step<T, const Name extends string>(name: Name & Literal<Name>, fn: () => Promise<T> | T, options?: StepOptions): Promise<T>;
    now(): Promise<number>;
    random(): Promise<number>;
    uuid(): Promise<string>;
    sleep<const Label extends string>(label: Label & Literal<Label>, until: number | Date, options?: SleepOptions): Promise<void>;
    poll<T, const Name extends string>(name: Name & Literal<Name>, check: () => Promise<T> | T, options: PollOptions<T>): Promise<PollResult<T>>;
    sayOnClient<const Name extends string>(name: Name & Literal<Name>, clientId: string, notice: SayOnClientNotice): Promise<string>;
    waitFor<S extends StandardSchemaV1>(token: string, options: WaitForOptions<S> & WaitForSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S> | undefined>;
    waitFor<S extends StandardSchemaV1>(token: string, options: WaitForSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S>>;
    waitFor<T = unknown>(token: string): Promise<T>;
    waitFor<T = unknown>(token: string, options: WaitForOptions): Promise<T | undefined>;
    report<const Name extends string>(name: Name & Literal<Name>, line: string): Promise<void>;
    signalToken(label: string): string;
    waitForSignal<S extends StandardSchemaV1>(label: string, options: WaitForOptions<S> & WaitForSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S> | undefined>;
    waitForSignal<S extends StandardSchemaV1>(label: string, options: WaitForSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S>>;
    waitForSignal<T = unknown>(label: string): Promise<T>;
    waitForSignal<T = unknown>(label: string, options: WaitForOptions): Promise<T | undefined>;
};

// @public @input
type WorkflowDef<P extends ToolInputSchema = ToolInputSchema, R = unknown> = {
    description?: string;
    input?: P;
    uploads?: readonly string[];
    output?: StandardSchemaV1<unknown, R>;
    run: WorkflowBody<InferSchemaOutput<P>, R>;
    onFailure?: WorkflowFailureHandler<InferSchemaOutput<P>> | undefined;
    describeRun?(run: WorkflowRunSnapshot<R>): string;
    cancelNote?: string | undefined;
};

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowFailureContext<I = unknown> = {
    readonly runId: string;
    readonly workflow: string;
    readonly input: I;
};

// @public
type WorkflowFailureHandler<I = unknown> = WorkflowFailureHook<I> | {
    run: WorkflowFailureHook<I>;
    maxAttempts?: number | undefined;
};

// @public
type WorkflowFailureHook<I = unknown> = (error: Error, context: WorkflowFailureContext<I>) => Promise<void> | void;

// @public
export type WorkflowModules = Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;

// @public
export type WorkflowRegistry = Readonly<Record<string, WorkflowDef>>;

// @public
export function workflowRegistry(modules: WorkflowModules): WorkflowRegistry;

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowRunBase = {
    runId: string;
    workflow: string;
    createdAt: number;
    key?: string;
    label?: string;
    startedAt?: number;
    settledAt?: number;
};

// @public
type WorkflowRunSnapshot<R = unknown> = (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "pending" | "running";
})
/** `output` is what the workflow function returned. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "completed";
    output: R;
})
/** `error` is the failure message. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "failed";
    error: string;
})
/** Cancelled by {@link WorkflowClient.cancel}; it produced no output. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "cancelled";
});

// @public
type WorkflowRunStatus = "pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed" | "cancelled";

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowSummary = {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    inputSchema?: unknown;
    outputSchema?: unknown;
    uploads?: readonly string[];
};

type DialogSendFromChecked<K extends string, R, E, T> = string extends K ? T : [K] extends [DialogSendFromKey<Exclude<R, ToolFailure>, E>] ? T : DialogSendFromMisuse<K, DialogSendFromKey<Exclude<R, ToolFailure>, E>>;

// @public
type DialogSendFromGuard<K extends string, R, E> = string extends K ? unknown : unknown extends R ? unknown : [K] extends [DialogSendFromKey<Exclude<R, ToolFailure>, E>] ? unknown : {
    sendFrom: DialogSendFromMisuse<K, DialogSendFromKey<Exclude<R, ToolFailure>, E>>;
};

// @public
type DialogSendFromKey<S, E> = keyof {
    [K in keyof S as S[K] extends EventNameOf<E> | undefined ? K : never]: never;
} & string;

// @public @sealed
type DialogSendFromMisuse<K extends string, Keys extends string> = {
    readonly "sendFrom names a result field that holds no event name of this dialog": K;
    readonly "the fields that do": Keys;
};

// @public @input
interface DialogSendOptions<R, E, K extends string = string> {
    sendFrom: DialogSendFrom<R, E, K>;
}

}

// @public @sealed
interface SessionEventMap {
    "agentTranscript.committed": {
        type: "agentTranscript.committed";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        text: string;

        recorded?: false | undefined;
    };
    "agentTranscript.updated": {
        type: "agentTranscript.updated";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        text: string;
    };
    "audio.completed": {
        type: "audio.completed";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "custom.emitted": {
        type: "custom.emitted";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        event: string;
        data: unknown;
    };
    // (undocumented)
    "error.reported": {
        type: "error.reported";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        code: SessionErrorCode;
        message: string;
        fatal: boolean;
    };
    "guardrail.blocked": {
        type: "guardrail.blocked";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        direction: "input" | "output" | (string & {});
        replacement: string;
    };
    "history.restored": {
        type: "history.restored";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        messages: {
            role: "user" | "assistant";
            content: string;
        }[];
        toolCalls: RestoredToolCall[];
    };
    "metrics.collected": {
        type: "metrics.collected";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        interrupted: boolean;
        latencyMs?: number | undefined;
        stt?: {
            endpointingMs?: number | undefined;
        } | undefined;
        llm?: {
            ttftMs?: number | undefined;
            durationMs: number;
            steps: number;
            inputTokens?: number | undefined;
            outputTokens?: number | undefined;
        } | undefined;
        tts?: {
            ttfbMs?: number | undefined;
            characters: number;
        } | undefined;
    };
    "provider.failedOver": {
        type: "provider.failedOver";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        stage: "stt" | "llm" | "tts" | (string & {});
        from: string;
        to: string;
        reason: string;
    };
    "reply.cancelled": {
        type: "reply.cancelled";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "reply.completed": {
        type: "reply.completed";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "session.configured": {
        type: "session.configured";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        audioFormat: string;
        sampleRate: number;
        ttsSampleRate: number;
        sessionId: string;
    };
    "session.reset": {
        type: "session.reset";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "session.timedOut": {
        type: "session.timedOut";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "speech.started": {
        type: "speech.started";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    // (undocumented)
    "speech.stopped": {
        type: "speech.stopped";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
    };
    "state.updated": {
        type: "state.updated";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        state: Record<string, unknown>;
    };
    // (undocumented)
    "tool.called": {
        type: "tool.called";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        toolCallId: string;
        toolName: string;
        args: Record<string, unknown>;
    };
    // (undocumented)
    "tool.completed": {
        type: "tool.completed";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        toolCallId: string;
        result: string;
    };
    "usage.updated": {
        type: "usage.updated";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        inputTokens: number;
        outputTokens: number;
        totalTokens: number;
        steps: number;
    };
    "userTranscript.committed": {
        type: "userTranscript.committed";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        text: string;
    };
    "userTranscript.updated": {
        type: "userTranscript.updated";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        text: string;
        eotConfidence?: number | undefined;
    };
    "userTurn.exceeded": {
        type: "userTurn.exceeded";
        meta: SessionEventMeta;
        limit: "words" | "duration" | (string & {});
        words: number;
        durationMs: number;
    };
}

// @public @sealed
interface SessionSlot<K extends string, T, V = DeepReadonly<T>> {
    readonly caps?: Readonly<Partial<Record<string, number>>>;
    create(): T;
    readonly durable: boolean;
    readonly empty?: () => T;
    get(ctx: SlotHolder): DeepReadonly<T>;
    readonly key: K;
    readonly projected: StateProjection<V>;
    reset(ctx: SlotHolder): DeepReadonly<T>;
    set(ctx: SlotHolder, value: T): DeepReadonly<T>;
    snapshot(ctx: SlotHolder): T;
    tool<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema, R = unknown, E extends {
        type: string;
    } = {
        type: string;
    }, K extends string = string>(def: SlotToolDef<P, DeepReadonly<T>, R> & SlotDialogGate<R, E, K> & NoInfer<DialogSendFromGuard<K, Awaited<R>, E>>, options?: DialogSendOptions<Awaited<R>, E, K>): DialogSendFromChecked<K, Awaited<R>, E, ToolDef<P, GatedOutput<R>>>;
    // (undocumented)
    tool<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema, R = unknown>(def: SlotToolDef<P, DeepReadonly<T>, R> & UngatedDef): ToolDef<P, R>;
    transact<Prep, R>(ctx: SlotHolder, tx: SlotTransaction<T, Prep, R>): Promise<R | ToolFailure>;
    update<R>(ctx: SlotHolder, mutate: (draft: T) => R): RejectThenableResult<R>;
    updateTool<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema, Prep = unknown, R = unknown, R2 = R, E extends {
        type: string;
    } = {
        type: string;
    }, K extends string = string>(def: SlotPreparedToolDef<P, T, Prep, R, R2> & SlotDialogGate<R2, E, K> & RejectThenable<R> & NoInfer<DialogSendFromGuard<K, Awaited<R2>, E>>, options?: DialogSendOptions<R2, E, K>): DialogSendFromChecked<K, Awaited<R2>, E, ToolDef<P, GatedOutput<R2>>>;
    // (undocumented)
    updateTool<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema, Prep = unknown, R = unknown, R2 = R>(def: SlotPreparedToolDef<P, T, Prep, R, R2> & RejectThenable<R> & UngatedDef): ToolDef<P, Promise<R2 | ToolFailure>>;
    // (undocumented)
    updateTool<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema, R = unknown, R2 = R, E extends {
        type: string;
    } = {
        type: string;
    }, K extends string = string>(def: SlotUpdateToolDef<P, T, R, R2> & SlotDialogGate<R2, E, K> & RejectThenable<R> & NoInfer<DialogSendFromGuard<K, Awaited<R2>, E>>, options?: DialogSendOptions<R2, E, K>): DialogSendFromChecked<K, Awaited<R2>, E, ToolDef<P, GatedOutput<R2>>>;
    // (undocumented)
    updateTool<P extends ToolInputSchema | undefined = ToolInputSchema, R = unknown, R2 = R>(def: SlotUpdateToolDef<P, T, R, R2> & RejectThenable<R> & UngatedDef): ToolDef<P, R2 | Extract<R, ToolFailure>>;
}

    output: R;
})
/** `error` is the failure message. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "failed";
    error: string;
})

    input?: P;

};

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowFailureContext<I = unknown> = {
    readonly runId: string;
    readonly workflow: string;
    readonly input: I;
};

// @public
type WorkflowFailureHandler<I = unknown> = WorkflowFailureHook<I> | {
    run: WorkflowFailureHook<I>;
    maxAttempts?: number | undefined;
};

// @public
type WorkflowFailureHook<I = unknown> = (error: Error, context: WorkflowFailureContext<I>) => Promise<void> | void;

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowRunBase = {
    runId: string;
    workflow: string;
    createdAt: number;
    key?: string;
    label?: string;
    startedAt?: number;
    settledAt?: number;
};

// @public
type WorkflowRunSnapshot<R = unknown> = (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "pending" | "running";
})
/** `output` is what the workflow function returned. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "completed";
    output: R;
})
/** `error` is the failure message. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "failed";
    error: string;
})
/** Cancelled by {@link WorkflowClient.cancel}; it produced no output. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "cancelled";
});

// @public
type WorkflowRunStatus = "pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed" | "cancelled";

// @public @sealed
type WorkflowSummary = {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    inputSchema?: unknown;
    outputSchema?: unknown;
    uploads?: readonly string[];
};

    sleep<const Label extends string>(label: Label & Literal<Label>, until: number | Date, options?: SleepOptions): Promise<void>;
    poll<T, const Name extends string>(name: Name & Literal<Name>, check: () => Promise<T> | T, options: PollOptions<T>): Promise<PollResult<T>>;
    sayOnClient<const Name extends string>(name: Name & Literal<Name>, clientId: string, notice: SayOnClientNotice): Promise<string>;
    waitFor<S extends StandardSchemaV1>(token: string, options: WaitForOptions<S> & WaitForSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S> | undefined>;
    waitFor<S extends StandardSchemaV1>(token: string, options: WaitForSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S>>;

    waitForSignal<S extends StandardSchemaV1>(label: string, options: WaitForSchemaOptions<S>): Promise<InferSchemaOutput<S>>;

// @public @sealed
export type WorkflowDeclaration<P extends ToolInputSchema = ToolInputSchema, R = unknown> = {
    description?: string;
    input?: P;
    uploads?: readonly string[];
    output?: StandardSchemaV1<unknown, R>;
    onFailure?: WorkflowFailureHandler<InferSchemaOutput<P>> | undefined;
    describeRun?(run: WorkflowRunSnapshot<R>): string;
    cancelNote?: string | undefined;
    body(run: WorkflowBody<InferSchemaOutput<P>, R>): WorkflowDef<P, R>;
};

// @public @input
export type WorkflowDef<P extends ToolInputSchema = ToolInputSchema, R = unknown> = {
    description?: string;
    input?: P;
    uploads?: readonly string[];
    output?: StandardSchemaV1<unknown, R>;
    run: WorkflowBody<InferSchemaOutput<P>, R>;
    onFailure?: WorkflowFailureHandler<InferSchemaOutput<P>> | undefined;
    describeRun?(run: WorkflowRunSnapshot<R>): string;
    cancelNote?: string | undefined;
};

// @public
export type WorkflowDefOf<App, Name extends string> = WorkflowsOf<App>[Name & keyof WorkflowsOf<App>];

// @public @sealed
export type WorkflowFailureContext<I = unknown> = {
    readonly runId: string;
    readonly workflow: string;
    readonly input: I;
};

// @public
export type WorkflowFailureHandler<I = unknown> = WorkflowFailureHook<I> | {
    run: WorkflowFailureHook<I>;
    maxAttempts?: number | undefined;
};

// @public
export type WorkflowFailureHook<I = unknown> = (error: Error, context: WorkflowFailureContext<I>) => Promise<void> | void;

// @public @input
export type WorkflowFollowOutputOptions = {
    namespace?: string;
    fromIndex?: number;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
};

// @public @input
export type WorkflowGetOptions = {
    wait?: number;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
};

// @public
export type WorkflowInputOf<D> = D extends {
    readonly run: (input: infer I, ctx: never) => unknown;
} ? I : D extends StandardSchemaV1<unknown, infer O> ? O : D extends {
    readonly body: (run: (input: infer I, ctx: unknown) => unknown) => unknown;
} ? I : never;

// @public
export type WorkflowNameOf<App> = [WorkflowsOf<App>] extends [never] ? never : keyof WorkflowsOf<App> & string;

// @public
export function workflowNameOf(def: AnyWorkflowDef): string | undefined;

// @public
export type WorkflowOutputOf<D> = D extends {
    readonly run: (input: never, ctx: never) => infer R;
    readonly output?: StandardSchemaV1<unknown, infer O> | undefined;
} ? Awaited<unknown extends O ? R : O> : never;

// @public @sealed
export type WorkflowRunBase = {
    runId: string;
    workflow: string;
    createdAt: number;
    key?: string;
    label?: string;
    startedAt?: number;
    settledAt?: number;
};

// @public @input
export type WorkflowRunListOptions = {
    limit?: number;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
};

// @public
export type WorkflowRunOf<D> = WorkflowRunSnapshot<WorkflowOutputOf<D>>;

// @public
export type WorkflowRunSnapshot<R = unknown> = (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "pending" | "running";
})
/** `output` is what the workflow function returned. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "completed";
    output: R;
})
/** `error` is the failure message. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "failed";
    error: string;
})
/** Cancelled by {@link WorkflowClient.cancel}; it produced no output. */
| (WorkflowRunBase & {
    status: "cancelled";
});

// @public
export type WorkflowRunStatus = "pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed" | "cancelled";

// @public
export type WorkflowsOf<App> = App extends {
    readonly workflows?: infer W;
} ? Extract<W, Record<string, unknown>> : never;

// @public @input
export type WorkflowStartAndWaitOptions = {
    key?: string;
    wait?: number;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
};

// @public @input
export type WorkflowStartOptions = {
    key?: string;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
};

// @public @input
export type WorkflowStreamOutputOptions = {
    namespace?: string;
    startIndex?: number;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
};

// @public @sealed
export type WorkflowSummary = {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    inputSchema?: unknown;
    outputSchema?: unknown;
    uploads?: readonly string[];
};

An agent is a directory\ncontaining `agent.ts`; the `aai` CLI bundles it and deploys it.\n\n## Read the SDK guide before writing agent code\n\nThe complete authoring guide ships inside the installed package:\n\n```text\nnode_modules/@alexkroman1/aai/AGENT_GUIDE.md\n```\n\nRead it with your file tools. // @public @input
export type CarrierCodec = {
    readonly name: string;
    decode(frame: unknown): CarrierInbound;
    encode(out: CarrierOutbound): unknown;
};

// @public
export type CarrierInbound =
/**
* The call's media stream has begun; `streamId` must be echoed on outbound
* frames. `callId` and `parameters` are the call's identity, bounded by the
* shipped codecs (see `MAX_CALL_PARAMETERS`). OPTIONAL so a codec written
* before they existed still type-checks; absent reads as "none".
*/
    {
    kind: "start";
    streamId: string;
    encoding: string | null;
    sampleRate: number | null;
    callId?: string | null;
    parameters?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
}
/** One 20 ms chunk of caller audio, base64 μ-law. */
| {
    kind: "media";
    payload: string;
}
/** The caller pressed a key: `0`-`9`, `*`, `#` (or `A`-`D` on carriers that send them). */
| {
    kind: "dtmf";
    digit: string;
}
/** The carrier is ending the stream (the caller hung up). */
| {
    kind: "stop";
}
/**
* Everything else — keepalives, marks, the other leg's audio, frame types
* this codec does not know. `type` is the carrier's own name for the frame
* (`""` when it carried none), for a log line; a session acts on none of them.
*/
| {
    kind: "other";
    type: string;
};

// @public
export type CarrierName = string;

// @public
export type CarrierOutbound =
/** One chunk of base64 μ-law agent speech. */
    {
    kind: "media";
    payload: string;
    streamId: string | null;
}
/**
* Discard agent audio the carrier has already buffered.
*
* This is what makes barge-in audible on a phone call. The carrier accepts
* audio far faster than it plays it, so at the moment the caller interrupts
* there are seconds of the agent's reply sitting in the carrier's own
* buffer — beyond the reach of anything the session drops on its side. Sent
* on `cancelled`/`reset`; without it the caller talks over an agent that
* keeps speaking for several seconds after being interrupted.
*/
| {
    kind: "clear";
    streamId: string | null;
};
